data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 1.6m release in 2015, compared to a GBP 4.1m release in 2014 (see Note 7).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 155.728m. The report records a small prior-year release (net of reinsurance) of GBP 1.6m in 2015 (2014: GBP 4.1m release). No quantified gross prior-year strengthening/deterioration is provided; the movement is presented net and described as a release, consistent with favourable claims development across the book. The gross claims development triangle shows minimal movement on older underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure available only as a NET release (GBP 1.6m) in the Managing Agent's report and Note 7. Prior-year development value reported here is NET of reinsurance because no gross movement note was provided.
